exam_scheme.note: Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies (JBIMS), University of Mumbai, conducts admissions to its 2-year full-time Master of Science in Finance (M.Sc. Finance / M.Fin.) program through a two-stage evaluation process comprising Application Rating based on CAT / MH-CET scores and an In-Person Assessment (IPA). The program was founded on the recommendation of former Prime Minister Dr. Manmohan Singh and modeled on the London School of Economics curriculum, with total sanctioned intake of 40 seats.

papers.qualifying_threshold: High percentile cutoff (typically 95+ percentile in CAT / MAH-CET)

papers.paper_name: Past Academic Record (Class 10th, Class 12th, and Bachelor's Degree)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 50% marks in Bachelor's degree (45% for reserved categories) with Mathematics at 10+2 level or higher

papers.paper_name: Extra-curricular Activities and Relevant Work Experience
